title: 12 · kubera · Kubera's Dinner Guest
lines: A child once ate the richest god's dinner.
Then the plates. Then the palace.
Kubera, the treasurer of the gods,
wanted Shiva to see how rich he had become.
Come to dinner, he said. I can feed anyone.
"Come to dinner," he said. "I can feed anyone."
Then the food for the other guests. Then the kitchens.
The plates. The tables. The golden pillars.
I am still hungry, he said. Shall I eat you?
"I am still hungry," he said. "Shall I eat you?"
Kubera ran all the way to Kailash and fell at Shiva's feet.
Shiva gave him a handful of plain puffed rice.
You cannot fill anyone with what you are showing off. Only with what you give. That is sadhana.
